lines.text: The Pharisees and Sadducees test Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
Jesus says they can read the appearance of the sky but not the signs of the times.
Jesus says no sign will be given except the sign of Elijah, and then He leaves them.
The disciples forgot to take nets, and they think Jesus' warning about leaven is about that.
Jesus reminds them of the loaves for the five thousand and four thousand, and they understand He meant the teaching.
